title: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
summary: TechCrunch 在10月17日跟进 The Verge 对 Meta 商业条款修订的报道，并引述 Meta 称删除争议表述不改变其网络爬虫做法。
investorNote: 该稿明确援引The Verge，不能当作第二份独立发现或新增发生。

fact.subject: Meta
fact.object: 商业条款中涉及网站内容用于AI训练的争议语句

evidence.quote:
And now,
The Verge reports
that the provision has been removed.

“We’ve heard you and want to clarify: the crawling terms we consolidated only applied to our ads and business products, and we’ve clarified that in the terms themselves,” the company said in a statement. “It does not change how Meta uses web crawlers.”

displayTitle: TechCrunch 跟进 Meta 商业条款撤回
narrative: TechCrunch 引述 The Verge 对 Meta 商业条款的发现，确认争议语句已移除，并记录 Meta 称爬虫做法不变。这是同一次条款修订的跟进报道，不新增一条独立新闻。

eventRelation.reason: 跟进稿明示援引The Verge，确认同一处商业条款语句移除
